title: Pre-Solicitation Notice - Water Reticulation & Septic System Rehabilitation Works
agency_path: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.US EMBASSY LUSAKA
detail_text: Pre-solicitaion Notice: Rehabilitation of a septic system and water reticulation system at a residence. The proposed water system repairs include excavations and trenching around the residential compound for the installation of new piping. Construction of the new concrete pad and installation of new water storage tank including all associated pump and piping Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. If you are interested in competing for this requirement, please provide a written request for a copy of the solicitation documents to the U.S. Embassy, Contracting Officer, GSO/Procurement Office : Lusaka-procurement@state.gov and it will be sent once available
